ResStock Measure Documentation: Advanced Air Sealing

item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**, the Advanced Air Sealing upgrade:

- **Applies to:** existing homes with baseline infiltration **≥6 ACH50**, across all climate zones. New construction and existing homes below 6 ACH50 are excluded.
- **Seals them to:** **5 ACH50**—five air changes per hour at a pressure difference of 50 pascals.
- **Covers:** **92.2% of existing dwelling units**; the remaining 7.8% are excluded.

Source: [*ResStock Measure Documentation: Advanced Air Sealing*](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy27osti/96738.pdf), Measure Summary (p. 1) and Applicability, Tables 4–5 (p. 5).
